role: Product Engineer and Independent Design Reviewer
conclusion: Use a local deterministic Python CLI and no web service, scheduler, ORM, Postgres, deployment, or wallet stack during bootstrap. SQLite is the reviewer's preferred transaction store, while the Root Agent may retain a file store only if it adds explicit single-writer and crash-recovery behavior and records the migration trigger.
required_capabilities: Deterministic ranking with explicit evidence and uncertainty
Allowed state transitions with append-only evidence
Distinct predicted, simulated, unrealized, and realized metrics
deliberately_deferred: Polling daemon or synthetic activity loop
Postgres, ORM, queues, vector database, dashboard, or cloud deployment
LLM integration inside the deterministic kernel
Wallet generation, signer, chain adapter, and treasury-sweep code

safe_concepts_only: Separated objective, opportunity, experiment, decision, reflection, and task records
Later non-root containers and read-only CI permissions
unsafe_to_merge: Race-prone work claims and incomplete recovery
